title: Synthetic Voice 'Olesya' by Storm-1516 Falsely Accuses Ukraine in U.S. Election Disinformation Campaign

behaviors.text: Russian operatives used AI to create a fake video and voice of "Olesya," a supposed troll in Kyiv, falsely claiming involvement in U.S.
intelligence confirmed the voice was AI-generated.
This disinformation [person] aimed to mislead voters, erode trust in democratic institutions, and influence the 2024 election.
The incident involved the group Storm-1516, individuals linked to [person], and potential veterans of the Internet Research Agency.
